repository.note: The checkout already contained uncommitted Concept 5D, 6A, and 6A.1 work. This audit records the working tree as found and does not replace or normalize those changes.

concept_6a.allowed_interpretation: validation infrastructure complete, real-data validation unavailable

evidence.canonical_RF_invariance: required and tested by snapshot comparison

remaining_blockers: lawful real receive-side measurements with raw export retained
neighbor/resource context for SINR, RSRQ, and RSSI

policies.frequency: 2.6 GHz and 28 GHz are reported separately
policies.matching: explicit transmitter/cell mapping; never strongest predicted cell
policies.censoring: detection floors remain censored evidence, never exact values
policies.receiver_height: height and provenance required; no silent 1.5 m default
policies.device_antenna: retain effects as provenance; do not silently compensate
policies.calibration: diagnostic-only frequency-specific constant bias, held out before any promotion

inventory.effective_cell_representation: project cell object plus normalized CellRFProfile
inventory.wire_request_identity: TowerRequestInput.id plus tower_lon/tower_lat/azimuth and optional rf_profile
inventory.eirp: not a first-class field; the canonical link budget expects conducted power plus absolute TX gain
inventory.antenna_pattern: finite built-in pattern IDs only; arbitrary source radiation files are unsupported

canonical_rf_profiles.model_family: 3GPP TR 38.901 UMa median outdoor urban path loss with deterministic height-aware footprint LOS/NLOS classification
canonical_rf_profiles.reference: 3GPP TR 38.901 V19.4.0 Table 7.4.1-1 UMa deterministic planning subset

profiles.tx_power_semantics: conducted transmitter output power before absolute TX antenna gain
conducted transmitter output power before absolute TX antenna gain

canonical_rf_profiles.link_budget: P_rx = P_tx(conducted) + G_tx,absolute - A_tx,pattern - PL - L_system - L_polarization + G_rx + calibration
canonical_rf_profiles.terrain: not used by the canonical urban_short_range RF path
canonical_rf_profiles.buildings: used for height-aware footprint LOS/NLOS classification when available

scenario_fingerprint_semantics.network_fingerprint: NetworkScenarioFingerprint normalizes the request, sorts towers by ID, and includes tower geometry/RF profiles, global RF inputs, optimization objectives/constraints, and radio-quality policy semantics
scenario_fingerprint_semantics.interference_fingerprint: InterferenceScenarioFingerprint normalizes the request, sorts towers by ID, and includes network/RF/resource/load/noise/threshold/co-channel policy semantics
scenario_fingerprint_semantics.validation_fingerprint: CanonicalRFValidationFingerprint includes dataset identity, observation checksum, adapter/evaluator versions, RF scenario, matching/applicability/residual/spatial/calibration policies
